claim: Dubai's 2025 Michelin Guide includes two 3-star and three 2-star restaurants
quote: 14 restaurants received one MICHELIN Star, three received two MICHELIN Stars, and for the first time, two restaurants were awarded three MICHELIN Stars

claim: FZN by Björn Frantzén and Trèsind Studio became the first three-Michelin-starred restaurants in Dubai in the 2025 guide
quote: Two Restaurants Awarded Three MICHELIN Stars for the First Time in Dubai

claim: FZN's tasting menu starts from AED 2,000 per person; reservations open on the 1st of each month at 10 AM local time
quote: Table reservations for the month in advance open on the 1st of each month at 10 AM local time

claim: Björn Frantzén is the only chef in the world to simultaneously hold three separate Michelin three-star restaurants (Stockholm, Singapore, Dubai)
quote: Björn Frantzén is the only chef in the world with three Michelin three-star restaurants

claim: FZN features an unmarked doorbell entrance; the meal begins in a Scandi sitting room with canapés before moving to an open kitchen for dinner
quote: With a simple ring of a doorbell, you are transported to an elevated dining experience set in what looks like someone's home

claim: Trèsind Studio's Immersive Degustation Menu is AED 1,350/person; open Mon–Sat 6pm–11pm at St. Regis Gardens, Palm Jumeirah
quote: AED 1,350 for the Immersive Degustation Menu

claim: Trèsind Studio is the first Indian restaurant in the world to receive three Michelin stars
quote: Dubai's Trèsind Studio wins three Michelin stars in world first for an Indian restaurant

claim: Trèsind Studio seats 20 guests in an intimate theatre around an open lab-like kitchen
quote: Resembling an intimate theatre, the 20-seater restaurant's focal point is the open lab-like kitchen where guests can watch each intricately plated dish come to life

claim: Il Ristorante – Niko Romito is at Bulgari Resort Dubai on Jumeira Bay Island; two Michelin stars for three consecutive years since 2022; reservations +971 4 777 5433
quote: awarded two Michelin stars by The Michelin Guide Dubai for 3 consecutive years since 2022

claim: Row on 45 is a 17-course tasting experience for 22 guests at the Grosvenor House Marina, unfolding across three acts: Champagne Lounge → open kitchen → Chef's Library
quote: The three-act dining experience unfolds across different spaces—beginning in the Champagne Lounge, continuing in the main dining room with a show kitchen, and concluding in the Chef's Library

claim: Row on 45 is located at The Grosvenor House, Dubai Marina, on the 45th floor; bookings via rowon45dubai.com
quote: Michelin dining experience Dubai | Row on 45

claim: Row on 45's 17-course tasting menu is priced at AED 1,345 per person
quote: Relish an unforgettable 17-course menu at two MICHELIN stars Row on 45

claim: STAY by Yannick Alléno is at One&Only The Palm at the tip of Palm Jumeirah in a colonial-style villa with tropical gardens and a private dock
quote: exclusively set at the end of the Palm in a colonial-style property, which is breathtakingly opulent in design, with magical tropical gardens and a private dock

claim: STAY's Émotions menu (4 courses) costs AED 900 and the Expérience menu (6 courses) costs AED 1,250; AED 500 pre-payment required to secure a booking
quote: The Experience Menu is AED 1,250 per person, and the Emotion Menu is AED 900 per person

claim: The Michelin Guide Dubai 2025 ceremony was held on 22 May 2025 at Address Sky View
quote: On Thursday evening, May 22, the Michelin Guide unveiled its 2025 Dubai edition at a dazzling, invite-only affair
